name: context-diet
description: Trims the skill listing to what the project kind needs (off by default); /context-diet shows what was dropped and the tokens saved

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Filter the skill listing by project kind. /context-diet on|off overrides it for the session

keep.title: Always keep
keep.description: Comma-separated skill names or prefixes ending in * that are never dropped (e.g. operation-*, persona-define)

drop.title: Always drop
drop.description: Comma-separated skill names or prefixes ending in * that are always dropped; keep wins over drop
